The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Masroor Airbase Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/pk/karachi/OPKC.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader sentiment for Karachi's August 4 peak temperature centers on monsoon-driven moderation, with 33°C holding the highest implied probability. Persistent moisture from the Arabian Sea and active monsoon low-pressure systems typically generate extensive cloud cover, scattered showers, and elevated humidity that suppress daytime maxima below seasonal peaks. Pakistan Meteorological Department outlooks indicate above-normal temperatures across Sindh for July–September 2026, yet early-August conditions often feature convective activity that caps highs near 32–34°C. Historical analogs and short-range model consensus point to limited clearing windows, favoring the narrow 32–34°C band over extremes. Updated PMD guidance and satellite monitoring of Arabian Sea circulation through August 3 remain the key near-term catalysts likely to refine these market-implied odds.
